messages.subject: True Corporation | AI transformation, sustainability and public-private stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear True Corporation Leadership Team,

True's 2026 strategy around AI, digital infrastructure and sustainable growth creates a strong fit with my experience managing transformation through institutions and operating systems.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate covers government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate coordination, social performance and executive stakeholder strategy.

My value is strongest where transformation depends on public trust, regulatory alignment and internal accountability. I lead multi-agency engagement, manage reputation-sensitive issues and coordinate complex action across technical and corporate teams. I also bring energy-transition and carbon-governance experience that strengthens my responsible-business perspective.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand or ASEAN responsibilities in Corporate Affairs, Public Policy, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships, Country Strategy or executive stakeholder leadership. I have attached a True Corporation-focused executive CV for review.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
